justifications.durability: Raised from 17 to 18: the prior durability deduction was the partly-tautological contract, now fixed, so a future refactor that echoed the caller's revision would redden. The stamp still sits at payload-assembly time inside the writer that persists the receipt, so a regenerated receipt carries source_revision automatically. One point remains withheld for the same structural reason the prior reviewer gave: the commits are local detached-HEAD commits reachable only from the reviewed worktree and not on any shared ref until the coordinator promotes them.
justifications.evidence: Raised from 18 to 20: the prior evidence deduction was the partly-tautological equality test, which the delta removes. Independently reproduced first-hand in this review. (1) The full gate re-run in the reviewed worktree at the reviewed head f0d841ac9 gives 18 passed, EXIT=0, matching after_suite.log. (2) The new discrimination claim was falsified by me directly: I built a copy of measure.py whose payload construction echoes the revision argument into source_revision (replacing the stamp_source_revision call), loaded it by spec_from_file_location, and built a payload with the 40-zero sentinel; the stamped value came out the sentinel and NOT the live tree revision (f0d841ac9...), so both assertions of the new test fail and the guard is shown to fire. The reviewed run's own negative-control-echo.log (revision 5d94508a9, 1 failed 17 passed, EXIT=1, failing exactly test_source_revision_is_rederived_not_echoed_from_the_revision_argument) and negative-control.log (revision 5d94508a9, 3 failed 15 passed, EXIT=1) both end with a bare EXIT line and are admissible. Reviewed-head arm at d90730fad logged separately.
justifications.fit: Unchanged at 19. justifications.goal_fidelity: Unchanged from the prior record at 19. The run's goal (plan nova:figure-and-solver-audit section 3, follow-up f-fsa-production-solver-receipt-writer-revision: route the production-solver receipt writer's payload through the shared source-revision stamp and regenerate nothing) remains met exactly, and the delta adds nothing to or away from that goal: 5d94508a9 strengthens the guard and f0d841ac9 records the evidence. The one carried deduction is the same the prior reviewer stated - the module-importability repair and the change of the revision source are adjacent behaviour changes beyond the literal request, disclosed and necessary but still more than stamping alone.
